-- Project Olympus: Hybrid Architecture Database Schema
-- Extends specs/03_data_model.yaml for L2/L3 Hybrid Layers

-- 1. Store the Causal Graph Structures (DAGs) generated by the LLM
CREATE TABLE causal_graphs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    regime_name TEXT NOT NULL,         -- e.g., "High-Vol Bearish Recovery"
    nodes JSONB NOT NULL,              -- List of variable nodes and their metadata
    edges JSONB NOT NULL,              -- DAG structure: [{"from": "node_a", "to": "node_b"}]
    llm_justification TEXT,            -- Reasoning behind the causal links
    version_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'v1.0'
);

-- 2. Store the Bayesian Inference results for every trade (The Audit Trail)
CREATE TABLE bayesian_trade_audit (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    trade_id UUID REFERENCES trades(id), -- Link to existing Olympus trade table
    graph_id UUID REFERENCES causal_graphs(id),
    
    -- Probabilities calculated at execution time
    p_assignment FLOAT NOT NULL,       -- P(Assigned | Context, Strike)
    p_profitability FLOAT NOT NULL,    -- P(Profit > 0 | Context, Strike)
    
    -- The specific CPT values used (Conditional Probability Tables)
    cpt_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,       
    
    -- Execution decision
    minimax_regret_score FLOAT,        -- Output from Risk Citadel
    action_taken TEXT                  -- e.g., "SELL_PUT", "ROLL_DOWN_AND_OUT"
);

-- 3. Regime Metadata for L1 "Regime-Tagged Storage"
CREATE TABLE market_regimes (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    timestamp_start TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    timestamp_end TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    vix_avg FLOAT,
    trend_slope FLOAT,
    sentiment_score FLOAT,
    regime_tag TEXT                    -- Indexed for fast L1 lookup
);

CREATE INDEX idx_regime_tag ON market_regimes(regime_tag);
